description: This Dart file defines the RideState class, which manages ride-related state in a Flutter application using ChangeNotifier. It includes properties for distance, ride request status, destination address, destination coordinates, and current address, along with methods to modify these properties and notify listeners.

classes.name: RideState
classes.description: A class that manages ride-related state for a Flutter app, providing get functions and methods to update state properties with change notification.

methods.name: setDistance
methods.description: Sets the trip distance and notifies listeners.

methods.name: requestRide
methods.description: Signals that a ride has been requested.

methods.name: setDestinationCoords
methods.description: Sets the destination latitude and longitude.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets ride state properties to initial values.
